title: CareLevo safety check retry times out during additional priming
body:
Description

Build version
- 4.0.0-dev-b (dda5)

Time of issue
- Reproduced during testing on July 30, 2026

Environment
- CareLevo patch connected
- Safety check retry flow

Steps to reproduce
1. Start the CareLevo patch connection / activation flow.
2. Proceed to the safety check step.
3. Trigger retry.
4. During retry, additional priming is executed.

Expected behavior
- Retry should proceed normally.
- If retry fails, the correct retry-related failure message should be shown.

Actual behavior
- A timeout occurs during additional priming in the retry flow.
- When this happens, an incorrect discard / patch termination failure message is shown.

Logs
- Relevant logs will be attached.
